script_system.script_relationship: Chinese carries identity and narrative priority; Latin is a materially smaller support layer.
script_system.type_family_behavior: Expressive irregular display lettering is paired with calmer serif-like Chinese support and compact Latin support.
script_system.language_hierarchy: Chinese first; Latin never competes with the display title or process hero.

title_architecture.statement: The compact irregular white display title anchors the upper-left while the wok action remains the dominant image read; title, subtitle and hero occupy one high-contrast field rather than a generic centered title stack.

evidence_pointer.region: upper-left title/subtitle and upper process band

glyph_mechanisms.statement: The title uses uneven stroke mass, rough controlled edges, compressed counters and non-uniform terminals to create force without becoming one oversized generic brush word.

evidence_pointer.region: upper-left display title and repeated compact marks

glyph_mechanisms.uncertainty: Exact glyph construction and distress texture are brand-bound until separately approved.

hierarchy_mechanisms.statement: Display identity, subtitle, medium campaign claim, module names, tags and microcopy create at least four distinct scale/density tiers with sharp jumps between them.
hierarchy_mechanisms.uncertainty: Exact role count and copy are production/brand specific.

layout_coupling.statement: Text roles are attached to process, ingredient, place and dining modules; their alignments describe semantic zones and keep type integrated with photography rather than pasted after image completion.

evidence_pointer.region: upper narrative layer, center modules and lower ingredient/world labels

layout_coupling.uncertainty: The exact three-band and three-card geometry is production-bound.

color_material_binding.statement: Warm off-white type maintains legibility across deep black photography and controlled red fields; distressed display edges echo the tactile brand world while functional copy stays materially cleaner.
color_material_binding.uncertainty: Exact black, red and ivory values are not invariant.

failure_modes.statement: Collapsing the system to one giant brush title, one dish and decorative red/black styling would remove the multi-tier information roles and campaign authorship visible in the reference.
failure_modes.uncertainty: Requires transfer validation; current causal status remains hypothesis.

figma_producibility.rationale: Exact brand title needs an approved lettering asset; Figma must not invent it from zero.
Exact copy and future content replacement require editable Chinese text.
Campaign claim is functional copy and must be exact.
Narrative copy must remain editable and verifiable.
Microcopy and explanatory text require exact characters and reflow.
Ingredient/category labels are content-bound and replaceable.
Badge geometry may be reusable, but its glyph content must remain live or use approved lettering assets.
English spelling and hierarchy must be deterministic.
Ordinary module labels stay live; only reviewed expressive glyph assets may be vector.
